headline: Heavy Fighting Rekindles on Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s pressure still centered on contested sectors, though the tempo has shifted since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, with 56 base events in 24 hours and three in the latest two, while its ledger stands at seven Warden holdings and two neutral sites; casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Callahan’s Passage has likewise intensified, reaching 35 daily events and two in the latest two hours, with eight Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base. Palantine Berm has cooled from its earlier burst to six recent events, but still records 33 across the day and remains divided six to one. Stlican Shelf has fallen to a single event in two hours after six in the last six, yet its 28-event daily record and eight Colonial to one Warden ownership keep it active. Nevish Line has gone quiet recently but retains 12 daily events and a seven-to-one Warden advantage. Stonecradle is quieter still, with ten daily events and one Warden base amid eight Colonial holdings.
